profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Infotech, Inc.
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience in the SaaS space, with a primary focus Ruby and Rails and AWS. My focus is on creating software that is scalable, efficient, and delivering value that addresses evolving customer needs and enhances user experiences.

My favorite part of the software development process is discovery. I love sitting down with stakeholders to fully understand and think through problems, before any code is written. I really enjoy turning business goals into engineering plans that not only are technically sound, but truly understand and solve user needs and pain points.

Currently, I lead the technical direction for a core SaaS product offering. I also contribute to a team maintaining an ecosystem of SaaS products in the civil infrastructure construction space. My daily responsibilities involve:
- Technical Leadership: Guiding architectural decisions and serving as the point person for product stability.
- Platform Engineering: Developing shared tooling and infrastructure to support our entire software ecosystem.
- Data & Analytics: Supporting data warehouse initiatives by understanding complex datasets, building views, and delivering valuable insights.
- Mentorship: Partnering with other engineers to maintain a high standard of software practices and solve difficult problems together.

Core Technical Skills:
- Programming Languages and Frameworks: Ruby on Rails, Python, C#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL
- Cloud and Infrastructure: AWS, CI/CD, SaaS Architecture
- Data Warehousing: AWS DMS and Redshift, DBT
- Other Focus Areas: UX, Technical Leadership, System Design, Data Analytics

If you share a similar passion for software development, please connect with me and let's chat! I'm happy to discuss anything from architectural best practices, interesting new technologies, or just brainstorming exciting new ideas!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop and maintain several web applications and RESTful APIs for digital construction solutions
* Act as a primary point of contact and technical lead on a production SaaS software application
    * Play a key role in driving design decisions, technical implementation, and production support

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
⦁ Played a core role in development & maintenance of a new application, bringing it from pilot phase into a full-scale production application
⦁ Created a robust suite of tools and enhancements to bring MTT of fully resolving critical production errors to less than one working day
⦁ Participate in university campus recruiting, student mentorship outreach programs, and mentoring interns and new hires

Technologies Used: Ruby on Rails, Python, C# with .Net Framework, VueJS, AWS Cloud Computing Services, Docker, Oracle SQL, Terraform/CloudFormation, CI using GitHub Actions, CD using AWS Code Pipeline

positions.title: Software Developer 1
positions.description:
⦁ Promoted to Software Developer 2
⦁ Worked in a collaborative environment using the Scrum agile framework with multiple teams of ~5 developers each
⦁ Involved in a full development lifecycle process including design, requirements gathering, writing documentation, and CI/CD deployment
⦁ Developed event-driven microservices with RESTful Web APIs and integrated them with enhanced monolith legacy systems
⦁ Maintained an in-house CIS software and its respective systems to improve its stability and ability to support ~150,000 customers
⦁ Integrated our CIS and payment systems with a cloud phone system enabling work from home and automating more than 13,000 hours of
call center work per year
⦁ Enhanced in-house billing and correspondence systems and integrated them with third-party vendor printing services, resulting in fewer
calls and emails for billing-related questions, fewer disputes, and an improvement in cash flow
⦁ Implemented multiple electronic correspondences, saving the company at least $60,000 a year in print costs
⦁ Implemented proactive monitoring, metrics and alerting for these systems to prevent any customer impact of potential issues
⦁ Worked both daily and weekly on-call rotations using PagerDuty, maintaining a mean time to acknowledge of less than 5 minutes to
ensure critical issues were immediately addressed and client-facing impact was minimized
⦁ Led a team dedicated to developing company culture and developer moral by planning weekly department events and coordinating
university outreach for in-office and remote environments
⦁ Aided with cultivating talent by running book clubs, tech talks, company guild initiatives, teambuilding events, and by recruiting and interviewing new candidates

Technologies Used: C#, ASP.Net Framework/Core, T-SQL, React/Redux, Docker, Kubernetes, ELK, CI/CD Pipelines, Microsoft Azure, RabbitMQ, Prometheus

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Undergraduate teaching assistant for the COP4600 - Operating Systems course taught at University of Florida.

⦁ Designed and produced shell scripts to automate project and assignment grading for a class of over 200 students
⦁ Led class discussion sessions, provided assignment help, and led tutoring sessions on course material
⦁ Created programming assignments and course documents

Technologies Used: Shell/Bash Scripting, C/C++

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
⦁ Contributed to development and maintenance of multiple Java projects and their pipelines
⦁ Created a universal hub for visualizations and dashboards of aggregated team testing data using Elasticsearch and Kibana

Technologies Used: Java (with Gradle and Spring), MongoDB, Concourse CI, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, ELK Stack

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
⦁ Used CI/CD and various scripting tools to implement a multi-system, end-to-end testing environment and improve overall automation of system deployments to increase productivity of a team of over 100 developers
⦁ Contributed to maintenance of systems and fixing bugs for a mission-critical project with a non-negotiable deadline

Technologies Used: C#, Ruby, T-SQL, MongoDB, TeamCity, PowerShell & Bash scripting

positions.title: Center Store Associate
positions.description: Experience in multiple areas of the store including: Customer Service, Produce, and Stocking. I resolved customer issues, built and maintained displays, graded and rotated stock, closed departments at night, and put out stock from delivery trucks.
